senses.definition: The interest, benefit, or wellbeing of someone or something.
senses.example: She appeared on behalf of the U.N. Secretary General at a conference held in behalf of the world's children.

senses.definition: One's role or rightful place; stead or authority.
senses.example: He was not only my Representative who died on my behalf; He was my Substitute who died in my very stead.
